title: Order-sign with no prefetch
demonstrates: The hospital bed order sent with no prefetch and no fhirServer, so the payer cannot see the patient or coverage. Use it to provoke and diagnose prefetch-missing.

expected.payerA: An error response for the missing prefetch (CDS Hooks says 412; the mock payers' prefetch-missing fault uses 400), reported by the diagnostics as prefetch-missing.
expected.payerB: The same: an error response for the missing prefetch, reported as prefetch-missing. Both variants send no prefetch.
